metadata_description: Clear answers about internship journals, reports, institutions, privacy and account setup.
title: Answers without the runaround
description: Search by topic and open only the questions you need.
contact_description: Tell us what you are trying to accomplish and we will route the request to the right place.
q1_question: Can Practicora work before cloud setup?
q1_answer: Yes. Local-first mode stores your workspace in the browser. Cloud synchronization can be enabled later without blocking initial use.
q2_question: What belongs in a professional internship entry?
q2_answer: Record hours, context, completed work, learning, blockers, feedback, next steps and authorized evidence. Practicora keeps the form structured without forcing every field.
q3_question: How do I avoid producing a 100-page report?
q3_answer: Choose a concise, standard or complete detail level, then filter the period and sections. Metrics can cover the whole period while the detailed journal is intentionally limited.
q4_answer: Only a Platform Director with the global permission can create an institutional workspace. Institution administrators can then invite their own members according to assigned roles.
q5_answer: No. Necessary storage supports core functions. Preferences, analytics and marketing choices remain optional and can be changed later.
q6_question: Why are social sign-in cards visible before setup?
q6_answer: Visibility helps teams understand the intended options. Unconfigured providers remain disabled and clearly display the required configuration instead of failing silently.
q7_answer: Practicora supports structured JSON backups and CSV exports. Reports can also be printed to PDF. Always follow your institution and employer confidentiality rules.
q8_answer: The shell, forms, calendars, filters and tables are designed for desktop, tablet and mobile. Dense views adapt instead of simply shrinking.
q9_question: Does Practicora replace an official security review?
q9_answer: No. The security page documents the current direction and controls, but a public deployment still requires environment-specific testing, configuration and review.
q10_answer: Use the guide for navigation questions or the contact form for account, institution, partnership or accessibility requests.
